display.title: Frontiers IV - The Final Frontiers
display.subtitle: The Deep Aether and the End
description: The last frontiers. The Deep Aether is Tier 4's first dimension - work
it to forge the End Compass that opens the way to the End itself.
Each first arrival still banks an Exploration bonus (Tier 4 content
mints the highest pool token - there is no separate T4 token; the
Ender Dragon is the finale, not a threshold).
§7Reach both below. The Abyss, if you find it, pays a bonus too.
